prompt: What are the lyrics to the popular, unofficial fight song of the university that the main character of Gilmore Girls attended?
answer:
The university was **Yale**, which Rory Gilmore attended in *Gilmore Girls*. Its popular unofficial fight song is **“Boola Boola.”**

The commonly sung lyrics are:

> From the far-off land of the Western sea  
> Came a song that is dear to me;  
> And it echoes down through the years  
> With a message of hope and cheer:  
>
> **Boola Boola, Boola Boola,**  
> **Boola Boola, Boola Boola,**  
> **Boola Boola, Boola Boola,**  
> **Boola Boola, Boola Boola!**  
>
> **Yale! Yale! Yale!**

“Boola Boola” was written in 1901 and is associated with Yale’s school spirit, although Yale’s official fight song is “Bulldog, Bulldog.”
